Single column, stacked vertically\n  - Order: About → Links → Contact → Social/Newsletter\n  - Spacing between sections: 32-40px\n  - Centered or left-aligned content\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] All 4 columns display correctly\n- [ ] Links functional and navigate correctly\n- [ ] Social icons link to correct profiles\n- [ ] Newsletter form functional\n- [ ] Email validation on newsletter form\n- [ ] Hover effects smooth on desktop\n- [ ] Responsive layout at all breakpoints\n- [ ] Text readable with good contrast\n- [ ] Icons display correctly\n\n---\n\n### F-FOOTER-002: Footer Bottom Bar (Copyright & Legal)\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nBottom section of footer containing copyright notice, legal links, and optional additional information.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Copyright text with current year\n- Links to legal pages (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service)\n- Optional: Developer credit or additional links\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Bottom Bar Section:**\n- Full-width horizontal bar\n- Border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) or subtle line\n- Padding: 24-32px top (separates from main footer)\n- Background: Same as footer or slightly darker\n- Text alignment: Center or split (left + right)\n\n**Layout:**\n- Max-width: 1200px, centered\n- Flexbox: Space between left and right content\n\n**Left Side Content:**\n- Copyright text:\n  - \"© 2024 Lumina Showcase. All rights reserved.\"\n  - Font size: 13-14px\n  - Color: Light gray (rgba(255,255,255,0.6))\n  - Dynamic year updates automatically\n\n**Right Side Content:**\n- Legal links:\n  - \"Privacy Policy\" | \"Terms of Service\" | \"Cookie Policy\"\n  - Font size: 13-14px\n  - Color: Light gray\n  - Separator: \" | \" or \" • \"\n  - Hover: White color, underline\n  - Opens in same tab or new tab\n\n**Optional: Developer Credit**\n- Text: \"Designed & Developed by [Company Name]\"\n- Font size: 12-13px\n- Color: Very light gray\n- Positioned: Right side or below copyright\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- **Desktop:** Left + Right split (space-between)\n- **Tablet:** May remain split or stack\n- **Mobile:**\n  - Stacked vertically, center-aligned\n  - Copyright first\n  - Legal links below (may remain horizontal or stack)\n  - Spacing: 12-16px between elements\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n\n**Legal Link Click:**\n- Opens respective legal page\n- Opens in same tab (internal pages) or new tab (external)\n- Smooth transition\n\n**Link Hover:**\n- Color brightens to white\n- Underline appears\n- Transition: 150ms\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Copyright notice displays with correct year\n- [ ] Legal links functional and navigate to correct pages\n- [ ] Bottom bar separates visually from main footer\n- [ ] Text readable with good contrast\n- [ ] Responsive layout on all devices\n- [ ] Hover effects work on legal links\n\n---\n\n## 10. Animation System Features\n\n### F-ANIMATION-001: Scroll-Triggered Animations\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nProgressive reveal animations that trigger as user scrolls sections into view, creating engaging and dynamic page experience.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Elements hidden or faded by default\n- Animations trigger when section enters viewport\n- Staggered animations for grouped elements\n- Runs once per page load (or on every scroll-in, configurable)\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n- No specific visual element, but affects how content appears\n\n**Animation Types:**\n\n**1. Fade In:**\n- Element starts: opacity 0\n- Element ends: opacity 1\n- Duration: 600-800ms\n- Easing: ease-out\n\n**2. Fade In + Slide Up:**\n- Element starts: opacity 0, translateY(30px)\n- Element ends: opacity 1, translateY(0)\n- Duration: 600-800ms\n- Easing: ease-out\n- Most common animation for sections\n\n**3. Fade In + Slide From Side:**\n- Similar to slide up, but translateX(-30px) or translateX(30px)\n- Used for side-by-side layouts (text from left, image from right)\n\n**4. Scale In:**\n- Element starts: opacity 0, scale(0.95)\n- Element ends: opacity 1, scale(1)\n- Duration: 500-700ms\n- Easing: ease-out\n- Used for cards, buttons, images\n\n**5. Staggered Group Animations:**\n- For multiple items (e.g., service cards, portfolio items)\n- Each item animates with slight delay after previous\n- Delay: 100-150ms per item\n- Creates cascading effect\n\n**Trigger Mechanics:**\n\n**Intersection Observer API:**\n- JavaScript observes when element enters viewport\n- Threshold: 20-30% of element visible triggers animation\n- Once triggered, class added to element (e.g., \"animate-in\")\n- CSS animation then executes\n\n**Configuration Options:**\n- Trigger once: Animation runs once, doesn't repeat on scroll out/in\n- Repeat on scroll: Animation re-runs each time element enters view\n\n**Animation Application:**\n\n**Which elements get animations:**\n- Section headlines\n- Section content blocks (text, images)\n- Cards (service cards, portfolio items)\n- Testimonials\n- Statistics/counters\n- Buttons/CTAs\n- Footer sections\n\n**Which elements DON'T animate:**\n- Header/navigation (always visible)\n- Hero section (visible immediately)\n- Small UI elements (links, icons within content)\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- **Desktop/Tablet:** Full animations as described\n- **Mobile:** Consider reducing or simplifying animations\n  - Option A: Same animations but shorter duration\n  - Option B: Simpler animations (fade only, no slides)\n  - Option C: Disable animations on mobile for performance\n  - Respected setting: prefers-reduced-motion (CSS media query)\n\n**Performance:**\n- Use CSS transforms and opacity (GPU-accelerated)\n- Avoid animations on layout properties (width, height, margin)\n- Intersection Observer is performant (better than scroll listeners)\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Animations trigger when scrolling to sections\n- [ ] Proper threshold (elements animate when ~30% visible)\n- [ ] Smooth animations without janking\n- [ ] Staggered animations have appropriate delay\n- [ ] Animations run once and don't repeat unnecessarily\n- [ ] No performance issues (60fps maintained)\n- [ ] Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion setting\n- [ ] Mobile experience smooth (animations reduced/removed if needed)\n\n---\n\n### F-ANIMATION-002: Hover Animations\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nInteractive animations that provide visual feedback when user hovers over clickable or interactive elements.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Immediate visual response to hover\n- Indicates interactivity\n- Smooth transitions\n- Desktop-only (no hover on touch devices)\n\n**Hover Animation Applications:**\n\n**1. Button Hover:**\n\n**Primary/Secondary Buttons:**\n- Background color darkens 10-15%\n- Scale: transform: scale(1.05)\n- Box-shadow deepens\n- Transition: 200ms ease\n\n**2. Card Hover (Service/Portfolio Cards):**\n\n**Card Container:**\n- Translate up: translateY(-8px)\n- Box-shadow increase\n- Transition: 300ms ease-out\n\n**Card Icon/Image:**\n- Scale: 1.1\n- Optional: Rotate(5deg) or color shift\n- Transition: 300ms\n\n**3. Link Hover:**\n\n**Navigation Links:**\n- Underline animation: width 0% → 100%\n- Underline animates from left to right\n- Transition: 250ms ease\n\n**Text Links (in content):**\n- Color shift: medium gray → accent color\n- Underline appears or thickens\n- Transition: 150ms\n\n**4. Image Hover:**\n\n**Portfolio/Gallery Images:**\n- Overlay fades in (dark gradient)\n- Image scales slightly: scale(1.05)\n- Text fades in and slides up\n- Overflow hidden (crop scale effect)\n- Transition: 300ms ease-out\n\n**5. Icon Hover:**\n\n**Social Media Icons:**\n- Scale: 1.1-1.2\n- Color change to brand color\n- Background circle appears (optional)\n- Transition: 200ms\n\n**Service/Feature Icons:**\n- Rotate: rotate(5-10deg)\n- Scale: 1.1\n- Color shift\n- Transition: 250ms\n\n**6. Input Focus (quasi-hover):**\n\n**Form Fields:**\n- Border color changes to accent\n- Glow/shadow appears\n- Transition: 150ms\n\n**Implementation Details:**\n- CSS :hover pseudo-class\n- CSS transitions for smooth changes\n- @media (hover: hover) to target only hover-capable devices\n- No hover effects apply on touch devices (prevents sticky hover state)\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Hover effects visible and smooth on desktop\n- [ ] Transitions between default and hover states fluid\n- [ ] No hover effects on touch devices\n- [ ] Hover clearly indicates interactivity\n- [ ] Transitions complete within 300ms max\n- [ ] No layout shifts caused by hover (use transform, not margin/padding)\n\n---\n\n### F-ANIMATION-003: Loading Animations\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nVisual indicators showing system is processing or content is loading, providing feedback during wait times.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Spinner or progress indicator during async operations\n- Replaces or accompanies button text during submission\n- Page preloader on initial load\n- Image placeholders during lazy load\n\n**Loading Animation Types:**\n\n**1. Button Loading Spinner:**\n\n**Use Case:** Form submission, CTA button actions\n\n**Visual:**\n- Small spinner icon (rotating circle/dots)\n- Size: 16-20px (fits in button)\n- Color: White (if button has dark background)\n- Position: Replaces button text OR appears before text\n\n**Animation:**\n- Rotation: 360deg continuous\n- Animation duration: 1 second\n- Animation timing: linear (constant speed)\n- Infinite loop\n\n**Button State During Loading:**\n- Disabled (not clickable)\n- Opacity: 0.7-0.8\n- Text: \"Sending...\" or hidden (just spinner)\n\n**2. Page Preloader:**\n\n**Use Case:** Initial page load\n\n**Visual:**\n- Full-viewport overlay\n- Background: White or brand color\n- Centered animation:\n  - Spinning logo\n  - Pulsing brand icon\n  - Rotating dots\n  - Progress bar\n\n**Behavior:**\n- Displays immediately on page request\n- Minimum display: 500ms (prevents flash on fast connections)\n- Fades out when page ready: 400ms fade\n- Removed from DOM after fade\n\n**3. Image Loading Placeholder:**\n\n**Use Case:** Lazy-loaded images\n\n**Visual:**\n- Placeholder div with same aspect ratio as image\n- Background: Light gray or subtle gradient\n- Optional: Pulsing animation (shimmer effect)\n\n**Shimmer Effect:**\n- Gradient moves across placeholder left to right\n- Creates \"loading\" appearance\n- Animation duration: 1.5-2 seconds\n- Infinite loop until image loads\n\n**Image Fade In:**\n- Once image loads: fade from opacity 0 to 1\n- Duration: 300-400ms\n\n**4. Content Loading Skeleton:**\n\n**Use Case:** Dynamic content loading (if applicable)\n\n**Visual:**\n- Gray rectangular shapes mimicking content layout\n- Pulsing/shimmer animation\n- Maintains layout structure\n\n**Example:**\n- Card skeleton: Gray rectangles for image, title, text\n- Animation: Pulse opacity 0.6 → 1.0 → 0.6\n\n**5. Progress Bar (Optional):**\n\n**Use Case:** Multi-step process or large upload\n\n**Visual:**\n- Horizontal bar\n- Width increases: 0% → 100%\n- Color: Accent color\n- Height: 4-8px\n- Positioned: Top of screen or within component\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Loading spinners display during async operations\n- [ ] Button disabled and shows spinner during form submission\n- [ ] Page preloader visible on initial load\n- [ ] Image placeholders maintain layout (no content shift)\n- [ ] Loading indicators smooth and professional\n- [ ] Spinners rotate without stuttering\n- [ ] Loading states replaced by content/success when complete\n\n---\n\n### F-ANIMATION-004: Micro-interactions\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nSmall, delightful animations providing feedback on user interactions, enhancing overall experience and polish.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Instant visual feedback on clicks/taps\n- Success/error animations\n- Attention-drawing pulses\n- Toggle animations\n\n**Micro-interaction Examples:**\n\n**1. Button Click Ripple:**\n\n**Trigger:** User clicks button\n\n**Animation:**\n- Ripple effect emanates from click point\n- Circle expands and fades out\n- Color: White or light color (contrast to button)\n- Duration: 600ms\n- Easing: ease-out\n\n**Implementation:**\n- Pseudo-element or JS-generated element\n- Position absolute within button\n- Transform: scale(0) → scale(4)\n- Opacity: 0.6 → 0\n\n**2. Checkmark Success Animation:**\n\n**Trigger:** Form submission success, task completion\n\n**Animation:**\n- Checkmark draws in with line animation\n- Circle background scales in or fades in\n- Color: Green\n- Duration: 600-800ms\n- Easing: ease-out\n- May include subtle bounce at end\n\n**Implementation:**\n- SVG with stroke-dashoffset animation\n- Or CSS animation on pseudo-element\n\n**3. Shake Animation (Error):**\n\n**Trigger:** Form validation error, incorrect input\n\n**Animation:**\n- Element shakes horizontally\n- Translate: 0 → -10px → 10px → -10px → 0\n- Duration: 400ms\n- Easing: ease-in-out\n- 2-3 shake cycles\n\n**Visual Cue:**\n- Border flashes red\n- Background flashes light red tint\n\n**4. Pulse Animation (Attention):**\n\n**Trigger:** Drawing attention to CTA, notification, new content\n\n**Animation:**\n- Scale: 1.0 → 1.05 → 1.0\n- Or opacity: 1.0 → 0.7 → 1.0\n- Duration: 1.5-2 seconds\n- Infinite loop or repeats 2-3 times\n- Easing: ease-in-out\n\n**Use Cases:**\n- CTA button (subtle pulse every few seconds)\n- Notification badge\n- Scroll indicator\n\n**5. Toggle Switch Animation:**\n\n**Trigger:** User toggles setting (if applicable)\n\n**Animation:**\n- Handle slides from left to right (or vice versa)\n- Background color changes\n- Duration: 200-300ms\n- Easing: ease-out\n\n**Visual:**\n- OFF: Handle on left, gray background\n- ON: Handle on right, accent color background\n\n**6. Number Counter (Statistics):**\n\n**Trigger:** Stat section enters viewport\n\n**Animation:**\n- Numbers count up from 0 to target value\n- Duration: 1500-2000ms\n- Easing: ease-out (starts fast, slows down)\n- See F-ABOUT-002 for full details\n\n**7. Tooltip Appearance:**\n\n**Trigger:** Hover over element with tooltip\n\n**Animation:**\n- Tooltip fades in and translates slightly\n- Translate: translateY(5px) → translateY(0)\n- Opacity: 0 → 1\n- Duration: 200ms\n- Easing: ease-out\n\n**8. Confetti (Celebration):**\n\n**Trigger:** Major success action (form submitted, purchase complete)\n\n**Animation:**\n- Colorful confetti pieces fall from top\n- Randomized: size, rotation, fall speed, horizontal drift\n- Duration: 2-3 seconds\n- Fades out at bottom\n\n**Implementation:**\n- Canvas or CSS animation\n- Triggered via JavaScript\n- Optional library: canvas-confetti\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Ripple effect on button clicks\n- [ ] Success animations display on form success\n- [ ] Error animations display on validation errors\n- [ ] Pulse animations draw attention appropriately\n- [ ] All micro-interactions smooth and polished\n- [ ] Animations enhance UX without being distracting\n- [ ] No performance impact from complex animations\n\n---\n\n## 11. Cross-Cutting Features\n\n### F-CROSSCUT-001: Keyboard Navigation & Accessibility\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nComprehensive keyboard navigation support and accessibility features ensuring all users can effectively use the website.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Full keyboard navigation via Tab key\n- Focus indicators visible\n- Logical tab order\n- Keyboard shortcuts for common actions\n- Screen reader compatibility\n- ARIA labels and roles\n\n**Keyboard Navigation:**\n\n**Tab Order:**\n- Follows logical reading order: top → bottom, left → right\n- Tab key moves focus forward\n- Shift + Tab moves focus backward\n- Focus skips over non-interactive elements\n- Focus trapped within modals when open\n\n**Focus Indicators:**\n- Visible outline or highlight on focused element\n- Color: Accent color or high-contrast color\n- Style: 2-3px solid outline or glow\n- Offset: 2-4px from element edge (outline-offset)\n- Never removed (outline: none only if custom focus style provided)\n\n**Keyboard Actions:**\n\n**Navigation:**\n- Tab: Navigate between interactive elements\n- Enter/Space: Activate buttons, links, form submissions\n- Arrow keys: Navigate within components (carousel, menu)\n- ESC: Close modals, dropdowns, menus\n\n**Modals:**\n- Tab: Cycles through modal interactive elements\n- Shift + Tab: Reverse cycle\n- ESC: Closes modal\n- Focus returns to trigger element on close\n\n**Carousel:**\n- Arrow Left/Right: Navigate slides\n- Tab: Focus on carousel controls\n\n**Forms:**\n- Tab: Move between fields\n- Enter: Submit form (if button focused)\n- Space: Check checkboxes, activate buttons\n\n**Skip Link:**\n- First focusable element on page\n- Link text: \"Skip to content\" or \"Skip to main\"\n- Positioned off-screen until focused\n- On focus: Appears visibly at top\n- Clicking: Jumps focus to main content (bypasses header/nav)\n\n**ARIA Implementation:**\n\n**Landmarks:**\n- `<header role=\"banner\">`: Page header\n- `<nav role=\"navigation\">`: Navigation menus\n- `<main role=\"main\">`: Main content\n- `<footer role=\"contentinfo\">`: Footer\n\n**ARIA Labels:**\n- Buttons without text: `aria-label=\"Close\"` (for X buttons)\n- Icon links: `aria-label=\"Facebook\"` (for social icons)\n- Form fields: Associated with labels via `for` attribute or `aria-labelledby`\n\n**ARIA Live Regions:**\n- Form errors: `aria-live=\"polite\"` announces errors\n- Success messages: `aria-live=\"polite\"` announces confirmations\n- Loading states: `aria-live=\"polite\"` or `aria-busy=\"true\"`\n\n**ARIA States:**\n- Expanded/Collapsed: `aria-expanded=\"true/false\"` (for mobile menu, accordions)\n- Hidden: `aria-hidden=\"true\"` (for decorative elements)\n- Disabled: `aria-disabled=\"true\"` (for disabled buttons/inputs)\n- Current: `aria-current=\"page\"` (for active nav link)\n\n**Screen Reader Considerations:**\n- All images have alt text (descriptive for content, empty for decorative)\n- Links have descriptive text (not \"click here\")\n- Form labels clear and associated\n- Error messages describe issue and solution\n- Dynamic content changes announced\n\n**Color Contrast:**\n- Text contrast ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 (normal text), 3:1 (large text)\n- Interactive elements: Minimum 3:1 contrast\n- Tested with WCAG AA standards\n\n**Text Sizing:**\n- Text scalable (no fixed pixel sizes that prevent zoom)\n- Layout doesn't break at 200% zoom\n- No horizontal scrolling when zoomed\n\n**Focus Management:**\n- Focus never lost (always visible indicator)\n- Modals trap focus within\n- On modal close, focus returns to trigger\n- Skip links allow bypassing repetitive content\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] All interactive elements keyboard accessible\n- [ ] Tab order logical throughout site\n- [ ] Focus indicators visible on all elements\n- [ ] ESC key closes modals/dropdowns\n- [ ] Arrow keys work in carousels\n- [ ] Skip link functional and visible on focus\n- [ ] ARIA labels present on icon buttons\n- [ ] ARIA landmarks defined\n- [ ] Form errors announced to screen readers\n- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards\n- [ ] Site usable at 200% zoom\n- [ ] Screen reader testing passed\n- [ ] Keyboard-only navigation test passed\n\n---\n\n### F-CROSSCUT-002: Browser Compatibility & Fallbacks\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nEnsuring consistent functionality and graceful degradation across all supported browsers and older browser versions.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Core features work in all modern browsers\n- Older browsers receive functional fallback experiences\n- Feature detection prevents errors\n- Polyfills for missing features\n\n**Supported Browsers:**\n- Chrome 90+ (last 2 versions)\n- Firefox 88+ (last 2 versions)\n- Safari 14+ (last 2 versions)\n- Edge 90+ (last 2 versions)\n- Mobile Safari iOS 13+\n- Chrome Android 90+\n\n**Feature Detection:**\n- Modernizr or custom detection checks\n- Detect support for: CSS Grid, Flexbox, CSS Variables, Intersection Observer, etc.\n- Apply fallback styles/scripts if feature missing\n\n**CSS Fallbacks:**\n\n**CSS Grid:**\n- Primary: CSS Grid layout\n- Fallback: Flexbox layout for older browsers\n```css\n.grid-container {\n  display: flex; /* Fallback */\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  display: grid; /* Modern browsers override */\n}\n```\n\n**CSS Custom Properties (Variables):**\n- Primary: CSS Variables for theming\n- Fallback: Hard-coded color values\n```css\n.element {\n  color: #3498db; /* Fallback */\n  color: var(--accent-color); /* If supported */\n}\n```\n\n**CSS Transforms/Transitions:**\n- Primary: Smooth animations\n- Fallback: Instant state change (no animation)\n- Graceful degradation: older browsers don't animate but still function\n\n**JavaScript Polyfills:**\n\n**Intersection Observer:**\n- Primary: Intersection Observer API for scroll animations\n- Fallback: Scroll event listener (less performant but functional)\n\n**Fetch API:**\n- Primary: fetch() for AJAX requests\n- Fallback: XMLHttpRequest for older browsers\n\n**ES6+ Features:**\n- Transpilation: Babel transpiles to ES5 for older browsers\n- Bundle includes polyfills: Promise, Array methods, etc.\n\n**Image Formats:**\n\n**WebP:**\n- Primary: WebP images (smaller file size)\n- Fallback: `<picture>` element with JPEG/PNG fallback\n```html\n<picture>\n  <source srcset=\"image.webp\" type=\"image/webp\">\n  <img src=\"image.jpg\" alt=\"Description\">\n</picture>\n```\n\n**SVG:**\n- Primary: SVG icons/graphics\n- Fallback: PNG icons if SVG not supported (very rare)\n\n**Video:**\n- Primary: MP4 video background\n- Fallback: Poster image if video fails to load\n\n**Font Loading:**\n- Primary: Web fonts (Google Fonts, custom fonts)\n- Fallback: System fonts (defined in font-family stack)\n```css\nfont-family: 'CustomFont', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;\n```\n- FOIT/FOUT: Flash of Invisible/Unstyled Text handled with font-display: swap\n\n**No-JavaScript Fallback:**\n- Core content accessible without JavaScript\n- Forms submit to server (not AJAX only)\n- Navigation functional (standard links, not JS-dependent)\n- Critical content rendered server-side (not dynamically inserted)\n\n**Browser-Specific Fixes:**\n- Safari: Specific fixes for date pickers, scrolling issues\n- IE11 (if supported): Polyfills for Grid, Variables, Fetch\n- Mobile browsers: Touch event handling, viewport bugs\n\n**Testing:**\n- Automated testing: BrowserStack, Sauce Labs\n- Real device testing: iOS, Android\n- Manual testing: Each supported browser\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Site functional in all supported browsers\n- [ ] Fallback styles applied for unsupported CSS features\n- [ ] JavaScript polyfills in place for older browsers\n- [ ] Image fallbacks load if modern formats unsupported\n- [ ] Font fallbacks display if web fonts fail\n- [ ] No console errors in any supported browser\n- [ ] Core functionality works without JavaScript (progressive enhancement)\n- [ ] Video fallback to image if video fails\n- [ ] Forms submit via standard POST if AJAX fails\n\n---\n\n### F-CROSSCUT-003: Performance Optimization\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nComprehensive performance optimizations ensuring fast load times, smooth interactions, and excellent user experience across all devices and connection speeds.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Fast initial page load (<3 seconds)\n- Smooth scrolling and animations (60fps)\n- Quick time to interactive\n- Optimized for slow connections\n\n**Load Performance:**\n\n**Asset Optimization:**\n\n**Images:**\n- Compressed: Lossy compression (80-85% quality)\n- Formats: WebP with JPEG/PNG fallback\n- Sizing: Multiple sizes via srcset for responsive images\n- Lazy loading: Images below fold load on scroll\n- Blur-up: Low-quality placeholder → sharp image\n\n**CSS:**\n- Minified: Remove whitespace, comments\n- Critical CSS inlined: Above-fold styles in HTML head\n- Non-critical CSS: Loaded asynchronously\n- One stylesheet (or minimal splits): Reduce HTTP requests\n\n**JavaScript:**\n- Minified: Variables shortened, whitespace removed\n- Bundled: Webpack/Parcel bundles modules\n- Code splitting: Load only needed code per page\n- Async/defer: Scripts load without blocking rendering\n- Tree shaking: Remove unused code from bundle\n\n**Fonts:**\n- Subsetting: Only include needed characters\n- Preload: `<link rel=\"preload\">` for critical fonts\n- Font-display: swap (show fallback immediately)\n- Limit font files: 2-3 font weights max\n\n**Videos:**\n- Compressed: H.264 codec, optimized bitrate\n- Resolution: Appropriate for display size\n- Fallback image: Poster image always provided\n\n**Loading Strategy:**\n\n**Critical Path:**\n1. HTML loads\n2. Critical CSS renders above-fold content\n3. JavaScript loads asynchronously\n4. Non-critical CSS loads\n5. Below-fold images/content lazy loads\n\n**Lazy Loading:**\n- Images: `loading=\"lazy\"` attribute or Intersection Observer\n- Offscreen content: Loads as user scrolls near\n- Threshold: 200-300px before viewport entry\n\n**Caching:**\n- Browser caching: Long-lived cache headers for static assets\n- Service worker: Caches assets for offline access (optional PWA feature)\n- CDN: Distributes assets globally for faster delivery\n\n**Runtime Performance:**\n\n**Animation Performance:**\n- Use CSS transforms and opacity (GPU-accelerated)\n- Avoid animating: width, height, margin, padding (triggers layout)\n- Prefer: transform, opacity (composite only)\n- RequestAnimationFrame: For JS animations\n\n**Scroll Performance:**\n- Passive event listeners: `{passive: true}` on scroll events\n- Throttle/debounce: Limit scroll handler frequency\n- Intersection Observer: Replace scroll-based detection\n- Minimize reflows: Batch DOM reads/writes\n\n**Image Rendering:**\n- Aspect ratio boxes: Prevent layout shift when images load\n- Explicit dimensions: Width/height attributes on images\n- Responsive images: srcset serves appropriately sized images\n\n**Resource Hints:**\n\n**Preload:**\n- `<link rel=\"preload\">` for critical resources (fonts, hero image)\n\n**Prefetch:**\n- `<link rel=\"prefetch\">` for next-page resources (if predictable navigation)\n\n**Preconnect:**\n- `<link rel=\"preconnect\">` for third-party domains (Google Fonts, APIs)\n\n**DNS-prefetch:**\n- `<link rel=\"dns-prefetch\">` for early DNS resolution\n\n**Core Web Vitals Targets:**\n\n**Largest Contentful Paint (LCP):**\n- Target: < 2.5 seconds\n- Optimize: Hero image loading, critical CSS, server response time\n\n**First Input Delay (FID):**\n- Target: < 100ms\n- Optimize: Reduce JavaScript execution time, defer non-critical scripts\n\n**Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS):**\n- Target: < 0.1\n- Optimize: Explicit dimensions on images/video, avoid inserting content above existing content\n\n**Monitoring:**\n- Lighthouse: Automated performance audits\n- WebPageTest: Detailed performance analysis\n- Real User Monitoring: Track actual user experience metrics\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Page load time < 3 seconds on 4G connection\n- [ ] LCP < 2.5 seconds\n- [ ] FID < 100ms\n- [ ] CLS < 0.1\n- [ ] Lighthouse performance score > 90\n- [ ] Images hover: translateY(-4px), box-shadow increase\n- Image hover: scale(1.05) with overflow hidden\n- Link hover: underline animation from left to right\n- Smooth transitions for all properties\n\n#### 4.10.3 Micro-interactions\n**Requirements:**\n- Button click ripple effect\n- Form field focus animations (border color, glow)\n- Loading spinners\n- Success/error animation indicators\n- Tooltip appearances\n- Menu open/close transitions\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Ripple effect on clickable elements\n- Focus state: border color change + subtle glow/shadow\n- Spinner animation: rotation or pulsing dots\n- Success: checkmark with scale/bounce animation\n- Error: shake animation + red highlight\n- Tooltip fade + slight translate on hover\n\n#### 4.10.4 Page Load Animations\n**Requirements:**\n- Initial page load animation sequence\n- Logo/brand entrance animation\n- Hero content staggered entrance\n- Optional preloader/splash screen\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Preloader: spinner or brand animation while page loads\n- Preloader fadeout when content ready\n- Hero elements animate in sequence: background → headline → subheadline → CTA\n- Stagger delay: 100-200ms between elements\n- Total initial animation: 1-2 seconds\n\n### 4.11 Responsive Design\n\n#### 4.11.1 Mobile Optimization\n**Requirements:**\n- Mobile-first design approach\n- Touch-friendly interface (minimum 44x44px tap targets)\n- Optimized font sizes for mobile screens\n- Simplified navigation for small screens\n- Reduced animations for performance\n- Fast mobile loading times\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Viewport meta tag configured for proper scaling\n- Mobile-specific interactions (tap, swipe, pinch)\n- No hover dependencies (all interactions accessible via tap)\n- Stack elements vertically on narrow screens\n- Increased spacing/padding for finger-friendly tapping\n- Image optimization for mobile bandwidth\n\n#### 4.11.2 Tablet Optimization\n**Requirements:**\n- Hybrid layout between mobile and desktop\n- Touch and cursor input support\n- Appropriate grid columns (2-3 columns)\n- Navigation accommodates medium screen width\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Breakpoint-specific layouts\n- May use hamburger menu or horizontal menu based on design\n- Images and content scale appropriately\n- Multi-column layouts where space permits\n\n#### 4.11.3 Desktop Optimization\n**Requirements:**\n- Full feature set with all interactions\n- Multi-column layouts\n- Hover states fully implemented\n- Optimized for mouse and keyboard navigation\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Maximum content width with centered containers\n- Cursor pointer on interactive elements\n- Focus states for keyboard navigation\n- Tab order follows logical reading flow\n\n#### 4.11.4 Large Screen Optimization\n**Requirements:**\n- Scaled layouts for very large displays (1440px+)\n- Content doesn't stretch awkwardly on wide screens\n- Maintained visual hierarchy and proportions\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Max container width prevents over-stretching\n- Background patterns or full-bleed images scale appropriately\n- Font sizes may slightly increase but remain proportional\n- Extra-wide screens use generous whitespace\n\n### 4.12 Performance Optimization\n\n#### 4.12.1 Loading Performance\n**Requirements:**\n- Page load time under 3 seconds on 4G\n- First Contentful Paint (FCP) under 1.5 seconds\n- Time to Interactive (TTI) under 3 seconds\n- Optimize asset loading\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Minified CSS and JavaScript\n- Compressed images (lossy compression accepted)\n- Lazy loading for images below fold\n- Async/defer script loading\n- Critical CSS inlined\n- Font subsetting and preloading\n- CDN usage for assets (optional)\n\n#### 4.12.2 Runtime Performance\n**Requirements:**\n- Smooth 60fps animations\n- No janky scrolling\n- Efficient DOM manipulation\n- Debounced/throttled scroll listeners\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- CSS transforms for animations (GPU acceleration)\n- Passive event listeners for scroll\n- Intersection Observer instead of scroll calculations\n- Minimize reflows and repaints\n- Efficient selectors and queries\n\n#### 4.12.3 Asset Optimization\n**Requirements:**\n- Image optimization and compression\n- Responsive image serving (srcset)\n- Modern image formats (WebP with fallback)\n- Icon sprites or SVG icons\n- Font optimization\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Multiple image sizes for different breakpoints\n- srcset and sizes attributes on img tags\n- WebP with JPG/PNG fallback\n- SVG optimization (remove unnecessary code)\n- Reduced font files (only needed character sets)\n\n### 4.13 SEO & Meta\n\n#### 4.13.1 On-Page SEO\n**Requirements:**\n- Semantic HTML structure (header, nav, main, section, footer)\n- H1-H6 hierarchy (single H1 per page)\n- Descriptive page title (50-60 characters)\n- Meta description (150-160 characters)\n- Alt text for all images\n- Descriptive link text (no \"click here\")\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Title tag: unique, includes primary keyword\n- Meta description: compelling, includes call-to-action\n- Heading structure: logical flow from H1 to lower levels\n- Alt text: descriptive and keyword-relevant\n- Image filenames: descriptive, hyphenated\n- URL structure: clean, readable, keyword-rich\n\n#### 4.13.2 Open Graph & Social Meta\n**Requirements:**\n- Open Graph meta tags for social sharing\n- Twitter Card meta tags\n- Social share preview image\n- Fallback meta tags\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url\n- twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image\n- Share image: 1200x630px\n- Absolute URLs for images\n\n#### 4.13.3 Technical SEO\n**Requirements:**\n- Favicon (multiple sizes)\n- robots.txt file\n- XML sitemap\n- Canonical URLs\n- Schema.org structured data\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Favicon sizes: 16x16, 32x32, 180x180 (Apple), 192x192, 512x512 (Android)\n- robots.txt allows all important pages\n- Sitemap includes all pages with priority and change frequency\n- Canonical tag to prevent duplicate content\n- Schema markup: Organization, Person, or WebSite type\n\n### 4.14 Browser & Device Compatibility\n\n#### 4.14.1 Browser Support\n**Requirements:**\n- Modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (last 2 versions)\n- Graceful degradation for older browsers\n- CSS feature detection (fallbacks)\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+, Edge 90+\n- Polyfills for essential features if needed\n- CSS fallbacks for unsupported properties (flexbox fallback, grid fallback)\n- Test in each supported browser\n\n#### 4.14.2 Device Testing\n**Requirements:**\n- Desktop (Windows, Mac)\n- Mobile (iOS, Android)\n- Tablet (iPad, Android tablets)\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Test on real devices or emulators\n- iOS Safari (iPhone, iPad)\n- Chrome Android\n- Portrait and landscape orientations\n- Various screen sizes representative of target audience\n\n---\n\n## 5. User Journeys\n\n### 5.1 First-Time Visitor Discovery Journey\n\n**Entry Point:** User lands on homepage (via search, link, or direct URL)\n\n**Steps:**\n1. Page loads with preloader/initial animation\n2. Hero section displays with animated headline and CTA\n3. User reads headline and subheadline to understand purpose\n4. User notices scroll indicator and scrolls down OR clicks CTA\n5. If scrolling: User navigates through sections (About → Services → Portfolio → Testimonials)\n6. User reads content, views images, interacts with interactive elements\n7. User arrives at Contact section\n8. User decides to reach out OR explore social media OR subscribe to newsletter\n9. If contact form: User fills form and submits successfully\n10. User receives confirmation and may continue exploring OR exits satisfied\n\n**Alternative Paths:**\n- User clicks CTA in hero → jumps directly to contact/conversion point\n- User uses navigation menu to jump to specific section of interest\n- User clicks on portfolio item → views detailed project → navigates to other projects\n- User gets distracted and exits early (should be minimized with engaging content)\n\n### 5.2 Returning Visitor Journey\n\n**Entry Point:** User returns to website via bookmark or previous link\n\n**Steps:**\n1. Page loads (faster due to browser caching)\n2. User recognizes the site immediately (consistent branding)\n3. User uses navigation to jump to specific section they want to revisit\n4. User finds the information they need\n5. User may take action they previously hesitated on (contact, share)\n6. User exits or explores new content\n\n**Alternative Paths:**\n- User lands on specific section via anchor link (hash in URL)\n- User checks for new portfolio items or testimonials\n- User shares specific content via social media\n\n### 5.3 Mobile User Journey\n\n**Entry Point:** User visits site on mobile device\n\n**Steps:**\n1. Page loads optimized for mobile\n2. Hero section displays properly on small screen\n3. User taps hamburger menu to see navigation (or scrolls immediately)\n4. User scrolls through stacked content sections\n5. User taps on cards or interactive elements (touch-friendly targets)\n6. User arrives at contact section\n7. User taps email/phone link to initiate communication OR fills contact form on mobile\n8. User successfully completes action or saves site for later\n\n**Alternative Paths:**\n- User views portfolio in grid layout and taps items for detail view\n- User swipes through testimonial carousel on mobile\n- User toggles mobile menu to jump between sections\n- User shares site via mobile share options\n\n### 5.4 Potential Client Evaluation Journey\n\n**Entry Point:** User arrives looking to evaluate credibility for potential engagement\n\n**Steps:**\n1. User lands on homepage and quickly scans hero section\n2. User navigates to About section (via menu or scroll) to learn more about company/person\n3. User reads about content and views credentials/history\n4. User navigates to Services/Features to understand offerings\n5. User reads service descriptions and may click for more details\n6. User navigates to Portfolio to see proof of work\n7. User browses portfolio items and clicks to view details of relevant projects\n8. User navigates to Testimonials to read social proof\n9. User reads multiple testimonials to validate quality\n10. User feels confident and proceeds to Contact section\n11. User completes contact form or calls/emails directly\n12. User awaits response\n\n**Alternative Paths:**\n- User doesn't find enough proof and exits without contacting\n- User bookmarks site to compare with competitors later\n- User navigates directly from Services to Contact (ready to convert quickly)\n\n### 5.5 Research & Exploration Journey\n\n**Entry Point:** User arrives via search or referral, exploring options\n\n**Steps:**\n1. User lands on homepage\n2. User spends significant time reading all content thoroughly\n3. User clicks on multiple portfolio items to understand depth of work\n4. User reads all testimonials and checks client logos\n5. User visits social media profiles (opens in new tab)\n6. User returns to main site\n7. User may fill contact form with questions OR subscribe to newsletter to stay updated\n8. User bookmarks or saves site for future reference\n9. User exits\n\n**Alternative Paths:**\n- User shares site with colleague/decision-maker\n- User downloads resource or whitepaper if available\n- User follows social media accounts for ongoing updates\n\n---\n\n## 6. Technical Requirements\n\n### 6.1 Frontend Technology Stack\n\n**Requirements:**\n- Modern HTML5 semantic markup\n- CSS3 with preprocessor (Sass/SCSS or PostCSS)\n- Modern JavaScript (ES6+)\n- Responsive framework or custom grid system\n- Animation library (AOS, GSAP, or Framer Motion)\n- Cross-browser compatibility\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- HTML: semantic tags, proper nesting, accessible structure\n- CSS: modular architecture (BEM, SMACSS, or CSS Modules)\n- JavaScript: vanilla JS or lightweight framework (React, Vue optional)\n- Build tools: webpack, Parcel, or Vite for SMTP\n- Form data validation and sanitization\n- Rate limiting on form submissions\n- Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB (if persistence needed)\n- Environment variables for sensitive configs\n\n### 6.3 Hosting & Infrastructure\n\n**Requirements:**\n- Web hosting with SSL certificate\n- CDN for asset delivery (optional but recommended)\n- Domain name and DNS configuration\n- Deployment pipeline\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- Hosting provider: Vercel, Netlify, AWS, or traditional hosting\n- SSL: Let's Encrypt or commercial certificate\n- CDN: Cloudflare, AWS CloudFront, or provider-included\n- Automated deployment via Git integration\n- Staging and production environments\n\n### 6.4 Third-Party Integrations\n\n**Requirements:**\n- Google Fonts or custom web fonts\n- Font Awesome or custom icon set\n- Google Analytics or alternative analytics (optional)\n- reCAPTCHA for spam protection\n- Email service provider API\n- Map service (Google Maps, Mapbox) if needed\n\n**Functional Details:**\n- API keys stored securely\n- GDPR-compliant analytics implementation\n- Fallback if third-party service fails\n- Async loading for non-critical third-party scripts\n\n---\n\n## 7. Content Requirements\n\n### 7.1 Required Content\n\n**Hero Section:**\n- Main headline (required)\n- Subheadline/tagline (required)\n- Background image or video (required)\n- CTA button text (required)\n\n**About Section:**\n- About headline (required)\n- About description text (2-3 paragraphs) (required)\n- About image or media (required)\n- Statistics/achievements if applicable\n\n**Services/Features Section:**\n- Section headline (required)\n- Service/feature cards (3-6 items):\n  - Title for each\n  - Description for each\n  - Icon or image for each\n\n**Portfolio Section:**\n- Portfolio items (6-12 recommended):\n  - Project preview image\n  - Project title\n  - Project category/tags\n  - Detailed description\n  - Additional images\n  - External link if applicable\n\n**Testimonials:**\n- Testimonial quotes (3-6 minimum):\n  - Quote text\n  - Client name\n  - Client role/company\n  - Client photo or avatar\n  - Optional rating\n\n**Contact Section:**\n- Contact form labels and placeholder text\n- Contact information (email, phone, address)\n- Social media links and profiles\n- Map address if using map embed\n\n**Footer:**\n- Footer text/description\n- Quick links\n- Legal links (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service pages)\n- Copyright text\n\n### 7.2 Content Preparation Guidelines\n\n**Text Content:**\n- Proofread for errors\n- Optimized for SEO (keywords naturally included)\n- Scannable (short paragraphs, bullet points)\n- Clear value propositions\n- Compelling CTAs\n\n**Images:**\n- High resolution (2x display density)\n- Optimized file sizes (compressed)\n- Consistent aspect ratios per section\n- Professional quality\n- Proper licensing/usage rights\n\n**Video:**\n- Muted for autoplay\n- Short duration for backgrounds (15-30 seconds looped)\n- Compressed for web delivery\n- Fallback poster image\n\n---\n\n## 8. Document Purpose & Scope\n\nThis Features Requirements Document (FRD) details all user-facing features for the Lumina Showcase web application. This document serves as the definitive specification for frontend development, UI/UX implementation, and user interaction design.\n\n### 1.1 What This Document Covers\n- All user-visible features and interface elements\n- User interaction patterns and behaviors\n- Visual and animated elements\n- Content presentation and structure\n- Navigation and routing\n- Form functionality and user input\n- Responsive behavior across devices\n- User feedback mechanisms\n\n### 1.2 Document Organization\nFeatures are organized by page section/component, with each feature containing:\n- Feature description and purpose\n- User-facing functionality\n- Visual/interface requirements\n- Interaction behaviors\n- Responsive considerations\n- Success criteria\n\n---\n\n## 2. Global Features (Present Throughout Application)\n\n### F-GLOBAL-001: Responsive Layout System\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nAdaptive layout system that provides optimal viewing and interaction experience across all device sizes from mobile phones to large desktop monitors.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Content automatically reorganizes based on screen width\n- Images scale proportionally without distortion\n- Text remains readable without horizontal scrolling\n- Touch targets are appropriately sized for device type\n- Navigation adapts to screen size (mobile vs desktop)\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n- Mobile (0-767px): Single column layouts, stacked content\n- Tablet (768-1023px): 2-column layouts where appropriate\n- Desktop (1024px+): Full multi-column layouts\n- Large Desktop (1440px+): Max-width contained with generous margins\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Layout reflows on window resize\n- Orientation changes (portrait/landscape) trigger appropriate layout\n- No horizontal scrolling at any viewport width\n- Smooth transitions during breakpoint changes\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] All content accessible at any screen size 320px and above\n- [ ] No overlapping elements at any breakpoint\n- [ ] Touch targets minimum 44x44px on mobile\n- [ ] Text readable without zooming on mobile devices\n\n---\n\n### F-GLOBAL-002: Fixed Navigation Header\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nPersistent navigation bar that remains visible at the top of the viewport as users scroll through content, providing constant access to site navigation.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Navigation stays visible during scrolling\n- Logo provides return-to-top functionality\n- Navigation items highlight based on current section\n- Background changes from transparent to solid on scroll\n- Smooth scroll to sections when nav items clicked\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n- **Initial State (Top of Page):**\n  - Transparent or semi-transparent background\n  - Full-height header (80-100px)\n  - Full-size logo\n  \n- **Scrolled State:**\n  - Solid background color\n  - Reduced height (60-70px)\n  - Slightly smaller logo\n  - Subtle shadow for depth\n\n**Desktop Navigation Items:**\n- Home\n- About\n- Services\n- Portfolio\n- Testimonials\n- Contact\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Header transitions smoothly (300ms) between states\n- Active section indicated with underline or color change\n- Hover state on nav items (underline animation or color shift)\n- Logo click scrolls to top with smooth animation\n- Nav item click triggers smooth scroll to section\n- Section URL hash updates during scroll\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Header remains fixed during scroll on all devices\n- [ ] Smooth transition between transparent and solid states\n- [ ] Active section always correctly highlighted\n- [ ] Clicking logo returns to top\n- [ ] All nav links functional with smooth scrolling\n\n---\n\n### F-GLOBAL-003: Mobile Hamburger Menu\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nCollapsible navigation menu for mobile and tablet devices, replacing horizontal navigation with a space-efficient slide-out or overlay menu.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Hamburger icon visible at tablet and mobile breakpoints\n- Menu opens with animated transition\n- Full-screen or partial overlay displays menu items\n- Close functionality via X button, menu item click, or backdrop tap\n- Body scroll locked when menu is open\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n- **Closed State:**\n  - Hamburger icon (three horizontal lines)\n  - Positioned top-right of header\n  - Size: 24x24px minimum\n  \n- **Open State:**\n  - Hamburger transforms to X icon\n  - Menu slides in from right or fades in as overlay\n  - Dark semi-transparent backdrop\n  - Menu items displayed vertically with large touch targets\n  - White or light-colored menu panel\n\n**Menu Contents:**\n- All navigation links (vertical stack)\n- Contact CTA button\n- Social media icons\n- Optional: Newsletter signup\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Tap hamburger icon → menu opens with 300ms slide/fade animation\n- Tap X icon or backdrop → menu closes with reverse animation\n- Tap any menu item → menu closes, smooth scrolls to section\n- Swipe left gesture closes menu (optional)\n- Body scroll disabled when menu open\n- Focus trapped within menu when open (keyboard accessibility)\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Hamburger menu appears below 1024px width\n- [ ] Menu opens/closes smoothly without janking\n- [ ] All navigation items accessible in mobile menu\n- [ ] Backdrop tap closes menu\n- [ ] Body doesn't scroll when menu is open\n- [ ] ESC key closes menu\n\n---\n\n### F-GLOBAL-004: Smooth Scroll Navigation\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nAnimated scrolling behavior when users navigate between sections via links, creating a polished and fluid browsing experience.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- All anchor links trigger smooth animated scroll instead of instant jump\n- Scroll animation accounts for fixed header offset\n- URL hash updates to reflect current section\n- Browser back/forward buttons work with section navigation\n- Direct URL with hash scrolls to correct section on page load\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n- No visual element per se, but provides smooth motion between sections\n- Duration: 500-800ms for scroll animation\n- Easing: ease-in-out for natural feeling movement\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Click navigation link → page smoothly scrolls to target section\n- Scroll position accounts for header height (no content hidden behind header)\n- Manual scrolling interrupts animated scroll\n- Hash in URL updates as user scrolls past section midpoints\n- Visiting URL with hash (e.g., #contact) triggers smooth scroll on load\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] All internal navigation links trigger smooth scroll\n- [ ] Scrolling stops at correct position below fixed header\n- [ ] URL hash updates reflect current section\n- [ ] Browser back button navigates to previous section\n- [ ] Page loads at correct section when hash in URL\n\n---\n\n### F-GLOBAL-005: Loading Animation / Preloader\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nInitial loading screen displayed while page assets load, providing immediate visual feedback and creating anticipation for main content.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Displays immediately on page load\n- Shows animation or spinner while content loads\n- Fades out smoothly when page is ready\n- Prevents flash of unstyled content (FOUC)\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n- Full viewport overlay\n- Background: solid color matching brand\n- Center-positioned animation:\n  - Spinning logo, OR\n  - Animated brand wordmark, OR\n  - Progress spinner, OR\n  - Pulsing dots\n- Animation: smooth, continuous, professional\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Appears instantly on page request\n- Minimum display time: 500ms (prevents flash on fast connections)\n- Maximum display time: 3 seconds (removes even if not fully loaded)\n- Fade out animation: 400ms\n- Page scrolling disabled until preloader removed\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Preloader visible immediately on page load\n- [ ] Smooth fade-out when content ready\n- [ ] Doesn't display on subsequent page interactions\n- [ ] Minimum 500ms display time enforced\n- [ ] Graceful timeout at 3 seconds\n\n---\n\n### F-GLOBAL-006: Scroll Progress Indicator\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nVisual indicator showing user's position within the page, helping with navigation awareness and engagement.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Shows how far user has scrolled through page content\n- Updates in real-time as user scrolls\n- Provides at-a-glance understanding of content length\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n- Thin horizontal bar at top of viewport (below or above header)\n- Height: 2-3px\n- Color: accent/brand color\n- Progress bar width increases from 0% to 100% based on scroll position\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Bar width animates smoothly during scroll (no jumping)\n- Calculation: (scrollTop / (documentHeight - windowHeight)) × 100\n- Visible after user scrolls past hero section\n- Hidden when at top of page\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Progress bar accurately reflects scroll position\n- [ ] Smooth animation during scrolling\n- [ ] Doesn't interfere with header or content\n- [ ] Reaches 100% when user scrolls to bottom\n\n---\n\n### F-GLOBAL-007: Back to Top Button\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nFloating action button that appears during scrolling, allowing users to quickly return to the top of the page.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Button appears after scrolling down 500-800px\n- Click triggers smooth scroll to page top\n- Button fades out when user returns to top section\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n- Circular button with upward arrow or chevron icon\n- Size: 48x48px\n- Position: fixed, bottom-right corner\n- Distance from edges: 24px (mobile), 32px (desktop)\n- Background: accent color with shadow\n- Icon: white or contrasting color\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Fade in animation when scroll threshold reached\n- Hover state: slight scale increase (1.1) and shadow enhancement\n- Click/tap: smooth scroll to top (800ms duration)\n- Fade out when user reaches top 200px of page\n- Pulse animation every 5 seconds to draw attention (subtle)\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Button appears after scrolling down 800px\n- [ ] Smooth scroll to top when clicked\n- [ ] Button disappears at top of page\n- [ ] Hover effect visible on desktop\n- [ ] Doesn't obscure important content\n\n---\n\n## 3. Hero Section Features\n\n### F-HERO-001: Dynamic Background Visual\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nFull-viewport hero section with high-impact dynamic background that immediately captures attention and sets tone for the website.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Large, visually striking background fills viewport\n- Background type options: high-res image, video, animated gradient, or particles\n- Responsive image/video serving based on device\n- Progressive loading with blur-up effect\n- Automatic fallback if video fails\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Background Options (Choose One):**\n\n1. **Static Image with Parallax:**\n   - High-resolution image (2560x1440px)\n   - Subtle parallax scrolling effect (background moves slower than foreground)\n   - Dark overlay (30-50% opacity) for text readability\n   - Image positioned: center center\n\n2. **Video Background:**\n   - Auto-playing video (muted, looping)\n   - High quality but web-optimized (max 5MB)\n   - Duration: 15-30 seconds loop\n   - Fallback to poster image on mobile\n   - Dark overlay for text contrast\n\n3. **Animated Gradient:**\n   - Multi-color gradient with smooth animation\n   - Colors shift slowly (20-30 second cycle)\n   - CSS-based for performance\n\n4. **Particle Animation:**\n   - Canvas-based floating particles\n   - Interactive (respond to mouse movement)\n   - Subtle, not distracting\n\n**Overlay Element:**\n- Semi-transparent dark overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.3-0.5))\n- Ensures text remains highly readable\n- Gradient overlay option (darker at bottom)\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- **Parallax Mode:** Background scrolls at 0.5x speed of foreground\n- **Video Mode:** Pauses on mobile devices, plays on desktop\n- **Particles Mode:** Particles subtly follow mouse cursor\n- Progressive image loading: blur → sharp\n- Loading priority: hero background critical resource\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- **Desktop:** Full background video or high-res image\n- **Tablet:** Optimized image or static frame from video\n- **Mobile:** Compressed image, no video (bandwidth conservation)\n- All breakpoints maintain aspect ratio coverage\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Background covers full viewport on all devices\n- [ ] Text remains readable on background\n- [ ] Video auto-plays on desktop (if video option)\n- [ ] Fallback image displays if video fails\n- [ ] Mobile serves optimized assets\n- [ ] Parallax effect smooth without janking (if parallax option)\n\n---\n\n### F-HERO-002: Animated Headline & Subheadline\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nPrimary messaging that introduces the website's purpose with eye-catching entrance animation, creating immediate engagement.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Headline and subheadline animate into view on page load\n- Text is large, bold, and immediately readable\n- Animation draws attention without being distracting\n- Responsive text sizing across devices\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Headline:**\n- Font size: 56-72px (desktop), 36-48px (tablet), 32-40px (mobile)\n- Font weight: 700 (bold) or 800 (extra bold)\n- Color: White or very light color (high contrast)\n- Max width: 800px\n- Line height: 1.2\n- Text alignment: center or left-aligned\n- Text shadow for additional contrast (subtle)\n\n**Subheadline:**\n- Font size: 20-24px (desktop), 18-20px (tablet), 16-18px (mobile)\n- Font weight: 400 (normal) or 500 (medium)\n- Color: White or light gray (slightly less contrast than headline)\n- Max width: 700px\n- Line height: 1.5\n- Positioned below headline with 16-24px spacing\n\n**Animation Options:**\n\n1. **Fade & Slide Up:**\n   - Headline fades in while sliding up 20px\n   - Duration: 800ms\n   - Delay: 500ms (after preloader)\n   - Subheadline follows with 200ms delay\n\n2. **Typewriter Effect:**\n   - Text types out character by character\n   - Speed: 50-80ms per character\n   - Cursor blinks during typing\n\n3. **Split Text Reveal:**\n   - Text splits into individual words/letters\n   - Each piece fades and slides in with stagger\n   - Creates cascading effect\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Animation triggers automatically on page load\n- Runs once (no repeat on scroll)\n- Text becomes selectable after animation completes\n- No animation interruption from user interaction\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- Font sizes scale smoothly between breakpoints\n- Line breaks adjust for narrow screens\n- Mobile may use shorter headline variant\n- Text remains centered in viewport vertically\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Headline visible and readable immediately\n- [ ] Animation smooth and professional\n- [ ] Text selectable after animation\n- [ ] Responsive sizing works at all breakpoints\n- [ ] High contrast maintained on background\n- [ ] Animation completes within 1.5 seconds\n\n---\n\n### F-HERO-003: Call-to-Action Buttons\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nProminent action buttons providing clear next steps for users, driving engagement and conversions from the hero section.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Primary CTA (main action)\n- Secondary CTA (alternative action)\n- Clear visual hierarchy between CTAs\n- Hover and click feedback\n- Mobile-optimized touch targets\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Primary CTA Button:**\n- Size: 48-56px height, auto width with padding\n- Padding: 20-28px horizontal, 12-16px vertical\n- Font size: 16-18px\n- Font weight: 600 (semi-bold)\n- Text: Action-oriented (e.g., \"Get Started\", \"Contact Us\", \"Learn More\")\n- Background: Accent/brand color (solid, vibrant)\n- Text color: White or high-contrast color\n- Border radius: 4-8px (modern, subtle rounding)\n- Box shadow: medium shadow for depth\n\n**Secondary CTA Button:**\n- Same dimensions as primary\n- Background: Transparent or ghost style\n- Border: 2px solid white/light color\n- Text color: White or light color\n- Font weight: 500 (medium)\n- Text: Alternative action (e.g., \"View Portfolio\", \"Watch Demo\")\n\n**Layout:**\n- Positioned below subheadline\n- Spacing from subheadline: 32-48px\n- Button spacing: 16px gap between buttons\n- Horizontally centered or left-aligned with text\n- Mobile: Stack vertically with 12px gap\n\n**Animation:**\n- CTAs fade in and slide up after headline/subheadline\n- Entrance delay: 1200ms (appears last)\n- Duration: 600ms\n- Easing: ease-out\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n\n**Hover States (Desktop):**\n- Primary CTA:\n  - Background darkens slightly (10-15%)\n  - Slight scale increase (transform: scale(1.05))\n  - Shadow deepens\n  - Transition: 200ms ease\n  \n- Secondary CTA:\n  - Background fills with light color/gradient\n  - Border color brightens\n  - Transition: 200ms ease\n\n**Click/Tap Feedback:**\n- Ripple effect from click point (material design style)\n- Brief scale down (0.95) then back to normal\n- Haptic feedback on mobile (if supported)\n\n**Loading State (if async action):**\n- Button disabled during processing\n- Spinner replaces text or appears before text\n- Opacity reduced to 0.7\n- Cursor changes to not-allowed\n\n**Button Actions:**\n- Primary CTA: Scrolls to Contact section OR opens contact modal\n- Secondary CTA: Scrolls to About/Portfolio section\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- Desktop: Buttons side-by-side\n- Tablet: Buttons side-by-side (if space) or stacked\n- Mobile: Buttons stacked vertically, full-width or centered\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Both CTAs clearly visible and readable\n- [ ] Visual hierarchy clear (primary stands out)\n- [ ] Hover effects smooth on desktop\n- [ ] Touch targets minimum 44x44px on mobile\n- [ ] Click actions functional and smooth\n- [ ] Buttons work with keyboard navigation (Enter key)\n- [ ] Loading state displays when action triggered\n\n---\n\n### F-HERO-004: Scroll Indicator\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nAnimated visual cue encouraging users to scroll down and explore content below the fold, improving engagement with full page content.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Subtle animation draws attention\n- Clicking triggers scroll to next section\n- Auto-hides after user scrolls or after timeout\n- Non-intrusive visual element\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Design Options (Choose One):**\n\n1. **Animated Chevron:**\n   - Double downward chevron (V V shape)\n   - Size: 32x32px\n   - Color: White or light color (semi-transparent)\n   - Bounce animation (moves down 8px and back, continuous)\n\n2. **Mouse Icon:**\n   - Outlined mouse shape\n   - Animated scroll wheel inside (moves down and fades)\n   - Size: 24x40px\n   - Line color: white/light\n\n3. **Arrow with Text:**\n   - Downward arrow\n   - Text below: \"Scroll Down\" or \"Explore\"\n   - Font size: 12-14px\n   - Arrow bounces\n\n**Position:**\n- Horizontally centered\n- Vertical position: 80-90% of viewport height (near bottom)\n- Distance from bottom: 40-60px\n\n**Animation:**\n- Continuous bounce or pulse (2-second cycle)\n- Moves down 8-12px then back\n- Easing: ease-in-out\n- Optional: Pulse opacity (0.6 → 1.0 → 0.6)\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n- Click/tap: Smooth scroll to next section (About)\n- Hover (desktop): Amplified animation or color change\n- Auto-hide triggers:\n  - User scrolls 100px or more\n  - Timeout after 8 seconds\n  - User clicks indicator\n- Fade out animation: 400ms\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- Present on all device sizes\n- May be slightly smaller on mobile (24x24px)\n- Positioning scales appropriately\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Indicator clearly visible on hero background\n- [ ] Animation smooth and continuous\n- [ ] Clicking scrolls to next section\n- [ ] Auto-hides after user scrolls\n- [ ] Doesn't obstruct other hero content\n- [ ] Visible across all device sizes\n\n---\n\n## 4. About Section Features\n\n### F-ABOUT-001: Section Layout & Content\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nInformative section presenting key information about the business/individual, establishing credibility and connection with visitors.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Clear headline introducing the section\n- Multi-paragraph content explaining story/mission/values\n- Accompanying image or media\n- Responsive layout alternating text/media positioning\n- Scroll-triggered reveal animations\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Section Structure:**\n- Full-width section with contained content\n- Background: White, light gray, or subtle brand color tint\n- Padding: 100-120px top/bottom (desktop), 60-80px (mobile)\n- Content max-width: 1200px, centered\n\n**Layout Pattern - Split View:**\n- 50/50 or 60/40 split (text/image)\n- Vertical alignment: center\n- Gap between columns: 60-80px (desktop), 40px (tablet)\n\n**Content Column:**\n- Section label/eyebrow: \"About Us\" or \"Our Story\"\n  - Font size: 14-16px\n  - Font weight: 600\n  - Color: Accent color\n  - Letter spacing: 1-2px\n  - Text transform: uppercase\n\n- Headline:\n  - Font size: 40-48px (desktop), 32-36px (tablet), 28-32px (mobile)\n  - Font weight: 700\n  - Color: Dark gray/black\n  - Line height: 1.2\n  - Margin bottom: 24px\n\n- Body paragraphs:\n  - Font size: 16-18px\n  - Line height: 1.7\n  - Color: Medium gray (#555 - #666)\n  - Paragraph spacing: 20px between paragraphs\n  - 2-3 paragraphs of content\n  - Max width: 600px\n\n- Optional CTA button:\n  - Similar to hero CTAs but smaller\n  - Positioned below last paragraph\n  - Margin top: 32px\n\n**Media Column:**\n- High-quality image:\n  - Aspect ratio: 4:3 or 16:9\n  - Rounded corners: 8-12px\n  - Subtle shadow for depth\n  - Alt text for accessibility\n\n- OR Video:\n  - Embedded video player\n  - Play button overlay\n  - Same dimensions/styling as image\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n\n**Scroll Animations:**\n- Trigger point: Section enters viewport (20-30% visible)\n- Text column: Fade in + slide from left (800ms)\n- Image column: Fade in + slide from right (800ms)\n- Stagger: Image starts 200ms after text\n- Easing: ease-out\n\n**Image Hover (Desktop):**\n- Subtle scale increase (1.02-1.03)\n- Transition: 400ms ease\n- Maintain rounded corners during scale\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- **Desktop (1024px+):** Side-by-side layout, 50/50 split\n- **Tablet (768-1023px):** Side-by-side possible, may go 60/40\n- **Mobile (0-767px):** \n  - Stacked vertically\n  - Image appears first, above text\n  - Full width elements\n  - Reduced padding and spacing\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Content readable and well-spaced\n- [ ] Image displays properly at all sizes\n- [ ] Scroll animations trigger appropriately\n- [ ] Layout responsive and logical at all breakpoints\n- [ ] Text contrast meets accessibility standards\n- [ ] Content hierarchy clear and scannable\n\n---\n\n### F-ABOUT-002: Statistics / Highlights\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nEye-catching numerical statistics showcasing achievements, impact, or key metrics, building credibility and trust.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Display of 2-4 key statistics\n- Animated number counting effect\n- Icons or labels for each stat\n- Grid layout for organization\n- Scroll-triggered animations\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Section Layout:**\n- Positioned below main about content\n- Background: Accent color, gradient, or image with overlay\n- Padding: 60-80px top/bottom\n- Full-width or contained based on design\n\n**Stat Cards Grid:**\n- 2-4 statistics displayed\n- Grid layout: 4 columns (desktop), 2 columns (tablet), 1-2 columns (mobile)\n- Equal spacing between cards: 40-60px\n- Cards centered in section\n\n**Individual Stat Card:**\n- Text alignment: center\n- Each contains:\n\n  1. **Icon (optional):**\n     - Size: 48-64px\n     - Color: White or accent color\n     - Positioned above number\n     - Margin bottom: 16px\n\n  2. **Number:**\n     - Font size: 48-64px (desktop), 40-48px (mobile)\n     - Font weight: 700-800 (extra bold)\n     - Color: White or accent color\n     - Animated counting effect\n     - Format: Includes commas, K, M notation (e.g., \"10K+\", \"99%\", \"250+\")\n\n  3. **Label:**\n     - Font size: 16-18px\n     - Font weight: 500-600\n     - Color: White or light color (if dark background)\n     - Text: Short descriptor (e.g., \"Happy Clients\", \"Projects Completed\", \"Years Experience\")\n     - Margin top: 8px\n\n**Example Stats:**\n- \"500+ | Projects Completed\"\n- \"10K+ | Happy Clients\"\n- \"99% | Satisfaction Rate\"\n- \"15+ | Years Experience\"\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n\n**Counter Animation:**\n- Trigger: Section enters viewport (30% visible)\n- Animation:\n  - Numbers count up from 0 to target value\n  - Duration: 1500-2000ms\n  - Easing: ease-out (starts fast, slows near end)\n  - Runs once per page load\n\n**Animation Example:**\n- Start value: 0\n- End value: 500\n- Duration: 2000ms\n- Increment calculated dynamically for smooth counting\n- Final number formatted (adds commas, suffixes)\n\n**Icon Animation (optional):**\n- Fade in + scale from 0.8 to 1.0\n- Happens before counter starts\n- Duration: 600ms\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- **Desktop (1024px+):** 4 stats in a row (if 4 stats) or 3 stats\n- **Tablet (768-1023px):** 2 stats per row (2x2 grid for 4 stats)\n- **Mobile (0-767px):** \n  - 1 stat per row (stacked) for clarity, OR\n  - 2 stats per row if space allows\n  - Reduced font sizes\n  - Reduced spacing\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Counter animation smooth and professional\n- [ ] Numbers count from 0 to target value\n- [ ] Animation triggers once when in viewport\n- [ ] Final numbers properly formatted\n- [ ] Icons (if used) display correctly\n- [ ] Layout responsive across all devices\n- [ ] High contrast for readability\n- [ ] Animation doesn't impact performance\n\n---\n\n### F-ABOUT-003: Timeline / Journey (Optional)\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nVisual timeline displaying company history, milestone achievements, or process steps, providing narrative depth and credibility.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Chronological display of events/milestones\n- Visual connector between timeline points\n- Date and description for each milestone\n- Progressive reveal on scroll\n- Responsive conversion to vertical on mobile\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Timeline Structure:**\n\n**Layout Options:**\n\n1. **Horizontal Timeline (Desktop):**\n   - Horizontal line across section\n   - Milestone nodes positioned along line\n   - Alternating content (above/below line)\n   - Requires wide screen space\n\n2. **Vertical Timeline (Recommended for responsiveness):**\n   - Vertical line on left side of content\n   - Milestone nodes on line\n   - Content to right of line\n   - Works across all device sizes\n\n**Using Vertical Timeline Structure:**\n\n**Timeline Line:**\n- Vertical line: 3-4px wide\n- Color: Light gray or accent color\n- Position: 40px from left edge of content\n- Height: Full section height\n\n**Milestone Nodes:**\n- Circular nodes on timeline line\n- Size: 16-20px diameter\n- Background: Accent color or white with border\n- Border: 3-4px solid accent color\n- Positioned at appropriate vertical spacing\n\n**Milestone Content (Each Item):**\n- Positioned to right of timeline line\n- Left padding: 80-100px (space for line + node)\n- Vertical spacing: 60-80px between milestones\n\n  1. **Date/Year:**\n     - Font size: 14-16px\n     - Font weight: 600-700\n     - Color: Accent color\n     - Margin bottom: 8px\n\n  2. **Title:**\n     - Font size: 20-24px\n     - Font weight: 600-700\n     - Color: Dark gray/black\n     - Margin bottom: 12px\n\n  3. **Description:**\n     - Font size: 15-16px\n     - Line height: 1.6\n     - Color: Medium gray\n     - 2-3 sentences\n     - Max width: 600px\n\n  4. **Icon/Image (optional):**\n     - Small icon or thumbnail\n     - Size: 60-80px\n     - Positioned to left of text or above\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n\n**Scroll Reveal Animation:**\n- Default state: Milestones hidden/faded\n- Trigger: Each milestone enters viewport\n- Animation sequence:\n  1. Timeline line draws/grows from top to current milestone (if animated line)\n  2. Node fades in with scale animation (0.5 → 1.0)\n  3. Content fades in + slides from left (20px shift)\n  4. Duration: 600ms per milestone\n  5. Stagger: 200ms delay between consecutive milestones\n\n**Node Pulse (optional):**\n- Active/most recent milestone node pulses\n- Subtle scale animation (1.0 → 1.2 → 1.0)\n- Every 3 seconds\n\n**Hover State (Desktop):**\n- Content area gets subtle background highlight\n- Node scales slightly (1.1)\n- Transition: 200ms\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- **Desktop:** Full vertical timeline as described\n- **Tablet:** Same layout, slightly reduced spacing\n- **Mobile:** \n  - Timeline line remains on left but closer to edge (20px)\n  - Content padding reduced (60px left)\n  - Font sizes slightly smaller\n  - Reduced vertical spacing between milestones (40-50px)\n\n**Example Timeline:**\n```\n2020 ━━ ● ━━ Founded Company\n          Launched our first project and established core values\n\n2021 ━━ ● ━━ Major Milestone\n          Reached 100 happy clients and expanded team\n\n2022 ━━ ● ━━ Innovation Award\n          Recognized for excellence in design\n\n2023 ━━ ● ━━ Expansion\n          Opened new office and doubled capacity\n```\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Timeline displays chronologically\n- [ ] Visual connector line clear and visible\n- [ ] Scroll animations smooth and sequenced\n- [ ] Content readable and well-spaced\n- [ ] Responsive layout works on mobile\n- [ ] Dates, titles, descriptions all display correctly\n- [ ] Animation doesn't impact page performance\n\n---\n\n## 5. Services/Features Section Features\n\n### F-SERVICES-001: Section Structure & Grid Layout\n\n**Feature Description:**  \nOrganized presentation of services or key features in a visually appealing card grid, helping users quickly understand offerings.\n\n**User-Facing Functionality:**\n- Grid display of service/feature cards\n- Section headline and introduction\n- Consistent card sizes and spacing\n- Scroll-triggered animations\n- Responsive grid reorganization\n\n**Visual Interface:**\n\n**Section Header:**\n- Section eyebrow/label (optional):\n  - Position: Top-right corner of modal\n  - Icon: ✕ (X)\n  - Size: 32x32px\n  - Color: Medium gray, darkens on hover\n  - Clear clickable area\n\n- Service title:\n  - Font size: 32-40px (desktop), 28-32px (mobile)\n  - Font weight: 700\n  - Color: Dark gray/black\n  - Margin bottom: 24px\n\n**Modal Content:**\n- Scrollable content area if exceeds viewport\n- Custom scrollbar styling (if desired)\n\n**Content Sections:**\n\n1. **Featured Image:**\n   - Initial: scale(0.9), opacity(0)\n  - Final: scale(1), opacity(1)\n- Easing: ease-out\n\n**Closing Animation:**\n- Reverse of opening\n- Modal scales out and fades: 250ms\n- Backdrop fades out: 200ms\n\n**Close Triggers:**\n- Click ✕ close button\n- Click backdrop (outside modal)\n- Press ESC key\n- Navigate to previous/next (modal content changes, not closes)\n\n**Body Scroll Lock:**\n- When modal opens: document.body overflow = hidden\n- When modal closes: document.body overflow = auto/default\n- Prevents background page scrolling\n\n**Focus Management:**\n- Focus trapped within modal when open\n- Tab key cycles through: close button → content links → CTA buttons → back to close\n- First focusable element receives focus on open\n- Focus returns to triggering element on close\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- **Desktop:** Full-featured modal as described\n- **Tablet:** Similar to desktop, slightly smaller\n- **Mobile:**\n  - Small previews: 60-80px width\n  - Aspect ratio: Match original or square\n  - Spacing: 8px gap\n  - Active thumbnail: Border or glow (accent color)\n  - Hover: Scale slightly (1.1)\n\n**Image Counter:**\n- Position: Top-left or top-center\n- Text: \"3 / 12\" (current / total)\n- Font size: 14-16px\n- Color: White semi-transparent\n- Font weight: 500\n\n**Zoom Controls (Optional):**\n- Zoom in/out buttons: + and −\n- Position: Top-right, near close button\n- Or: Mouse wheel zoom\n- Zoom levels: 100%, 150%, 200%\n\n**Interaction Behavior:**\n\n**Opening Lightbox:**\n- Triggered by clicking gallery image\n- Animation:\n  - Image scales down and fades: 300ms\n  - Backdrop and controls fade out: 200ms\n\n**Navigating Images:**\n- Click next arrow → Image fades out (200ms) → Next image fades in (300ms)\n- Click previous arrow → Same behavior for previous image\n- Click thumbnail → Smooth transition to that image\n- Keyboard navigation:\n  - Left arrow key: Previous image\n  - Right arrow key: Next image\n  - ESC key: Close lightbox\n\n**Swipe Gestures (Mobile/Touch):**\n- Swipe left: Next image\n- Swipe right: Previous image\n- Pinch to zoom: Zoom in/out on image\n\n**Zoom Functionality:**\n- Click image or + button: Zoom in\n- Click − button: Zoom out\n- When zoomed: Image pannable by dragging\n- Double-tap: Toggle zoom in/out\n\n**Loop Behavior:**\n- Option A: At last image, next button disabled/hidden\n- Option B: Loop - after last image, next goes to first image\n\n**Thumbnail Strip Overflow:**\n- If many images, thumbnail strip scrollable horizontally\n- Active thumbnail auto-scrolls into view\n- Smooth scroll animation\n\n**Responsive Behavior:**\n- **Desktop:**\n  - Full features\n  - Large arrows on sides\n  - Thumbnail strip at bottom\n  - Mouse wheel zoom\n\n- **Tablet:**\n  - Similar to desktop\n  - Touch-friendly controls\n\n- **Mobile:**\n  - Simplified UI\n  - Arrows smaller or overlay-on-image\n  - Thumbnail strip may be hidden (swipe to navigate)\n  - Swipe gestures primary navigation\n  - Tap image to toggle UI visibility\n\n**Success Criteria:**\n- [ ] Lightbox opens full-screen with smooth animation\n- [ ] Main image centered and properly sized\n- [ ] Previous/next navigation functional\n- [ ] Thumbnail strip displays all images\n- [ ] Clicking thumbnail navigates to that image\n- [ ] Image counter shows current/total\n- [ ] Close button, ESC, and backdrop click close lightbox\n- [ ] Keyboard arrows navigate images\n- [ ] Swipe gestures work on touch devices\n- [ ] Zoom functionality works (if implemented)\n- [ ] Images load promptly\n- [ ] Maintains aspect ratios at all zoom levels\n- [ ] No UI controls over image content (proper positioning)\n- [ ] Smooth transitions between images\n\n---\n\n## 7.
